_meta.ptally/summary: Lists the quotes your projects have priced, newest first, with each one's price, whether it was valid and how long it took. Filter by project or version.
_meta.swallow/summary: Lists the quotes your projects have priced, newest first, with each one's price, whether it was valid and how long it took. Filter by project or version.

description: List quotes stored on this self-host instance, newest first (`direction: "asc"` for oldest first). Filter by `project_reference` (from get_projects), `version_reference`, `since` (ISO date) or `search` (text match on indicators). Paged with `limit` (default 25, max 100) and `offset`; `has_more` says whether another page exists. Returns `{ count, limit, offset, has_more, quotes: [{ quote_reference, project_reference, project_name, version_reference, version, created_at, status, valid, result, indicator, client_ref, exec_time_ms, error, amended_result, amended_valid, sold, quote_url }], next_steps }` — `result` and `valid` are what the engine priced; `amended_result` / `amended_valid` (null when not amended) are what someone changed them to in the dashboard, and `sold` (null when never set) whether it sold. No input or output payloads; call get_quote for one quote's full review. Dry runs (run_quote without save, run_version_tests) are never stored, so they never appear here; run_quote with save: true does.

direction.description: Optional. desc (newest first, default) or asc.

offset.description: Optional. Rows to skip, for paging.

project_reference.description: Optional. Only quotes for this project (get_projects lists them).

search.description: Optional. Text to match in the quote's indicators.

since.description: Optional. ISO date or date-time; only quotes created at or after it.

version_reference.description: Optional. Only quotes priced by this version.

name: get_quotes
title: List quotes
